title: NIGHT THREE
lines: This is Halloran. Night three on P3.|Cam 14 turned toward me again. I didn't move.|They said stay on camera. Nobody said why.|Something stood by the ramp. Through the camcorder there was nothing there.
note: the first tape: the old guard

title: ORIENTATION
lines: Kestrel and Vane orientation. Tape two.|Rule one: the cameras never go off. Not for repairs. Not for anything.|If the power fails find a lit camera and remain in its view.|Do not leave P3 dark. We will know.

title: BLIND SPOTS
lines: I counted the blind spots tonight. There are more than yesterday.|The pillars make them. The cars make them.|It doesn't walk through the light. It walks around it.|I think it is learning the cameras.

title: THE LINES
lines: Someone cut the line to cam nine.|There is no one on this level but me.|The cut is clean. Like it was bitten.|When I spliced it the camera looked at me. Then it looked behind me.

title: THE ROOM ON P4
lines: There is a room on P4 with no cameras.|They plastered it shut in 1979.|I put my ear to the wall.|Something on the other side was holding its breath.

title: WHAT THE CAMERA SAW
lines: I played back what I filmed in the room on P4.|Forty seconds of an empty room.|At thirty-one seconds the timecode stops. Then it starts again at thirty-one.|Something stood in that second.
note: after the finale: what the camcorder filmed

title: MEMO P4-07
lines: Internal memo. To all night staff.|Room P4-07 is to remain sealed. No camera is to be installed in P4-07.|Any footage of P4-07 is property of Kestrel and Vane.|Do not watch it. Bring it up.

title: THE DISPATCHER
lines: I asked the office who was on the radio last night.|They said nobody. The dispatcher clocks out at midnight.|I have heard her every night at two.|Then who tells me to stay on camera?
note: the radio is not who you think

title: LAST NIGHT
lines: Two minutes to six.|Every camera on P3 is turned toward me.|Not at me. Behind me.|If you find this don't turn around. Turn the camcorder around.

title: SIX A.M.
lines: This is the day guard. I came down at six.|The night guard's chair was warm. The camcorder was still recording.|The tape was full of P3. Empty. From every angle.|I am leaving this one in the dark for the next one of you.
